assessment_rules: The use of unauthorized materials or electronic devices during an evaluation test may lead to the immediate withdrawal of the exam and a failing grade (numeric '0'). The responsible professor may also report the incident for disciplinary action due to academic fraud. For continuous assessment exams, further continuous evaluation may be disallowed unless specified otherwise in the academic guide. For ordinary or extraordinary exams, the opening of disciplinary proceedings will result in a 'pending resolution' status on the transcript until the process is concluded.
